name: Dahla
title: The Dancer
description: The memories of an entertainer trapped in a moment. Dahla performs for an audience that only she can see. This Eternal is highly mobile, dangerous at any distance, and able to sustain her allies with healing.

coreAbility.name: Curtain Call
coreAbility.description: Pull in distant enemies, stunning them.

name: Edani
title: The Mistress of Suffering
description: The memories of a tortured writer. Edani knows suffering and wants to share it. Excelling in isolation, this Eternal hooks, claws, and banishes her prey before ripping them apart.

coreAbility.name: Banish
coreAbility.description: Banish an enemy to another realm.

name: Irenna
title: The Maul
description: The memories of a knight who failed. Irenna is a durable frontline combatant. This Eternal fights like a bear, preferring to maul her enemies.

coreAbility.name: Spiral Strike
coreAbility.description: A spin attack that lifesteals and heals teammates.

setBonus.name: Cold-blooded
setBonus.description: 25% Increased damage to stunned or slowed enemies

name: Ravah
title: The Fading Huntress
description: The memories of a bounty hunter who was caged in a Tower. Ravah stalks her targets, using smoke and shadow to confuse her enemies. This Eternal deals devastating bursts of damage at long range.

coreAbility.name: The Parliament
coreAbility.description: Summon a damaging ring of owls that follow your ringblade when thrown.

name: Hollow
title: The Forest Darkling
description: The memories of an outcast. Hollow prefers the Tower to the living world. This Eternal is aided by her gloomies, strange creatures born of feeling and memory.

coreAbility.name: Gloomy Swarm
coreAbility.description: Release a stream of Gloomies that seek out the closest target within 45 degrees.

setBonus.name: Unscathed
setBonus.description: 25% Bonus damage while you have Fortitude

name: Leodin
title: The Lightbringer
description: The memories of a warrior who had faith in himself. The Lightbringer is a god or a madman. This Eternal can take to the sky, reflect projectiles, and punch through armor with his glint spear.

coreAbility.name: Sky Strike
coreAbility.description: Launch into the sky and crash down, stunning enemies on arrival.

name: Karriv
title: The Forge
description: The memories of a weaponsmith destined to lead others to ruin. Karriv is a resilient protector. This Eternal excels at defending an area and forcing opponents to fight on his terms.

coreAbility.name: Fire Cage
coreAbility.description: A stomp attack that damages nearby enemies and summons a collapsing ring of fire.

name: Rynshi
title: The Beast
description: The memories of a berserker with blood on his hands. Rynshi knows that the Beast belongs here, with the other monsters. This Eternal stuns and blinds his victims before ripping them apart.

coreAbility.name: Rampage
coreAbility.description: Enter a frenzied state. Abilies are refreshed. When rampaging you move faster.

name: Vaton
title: The Charlatan
description: The memories of a snake in the grass. Vaton is a villain who hunts tyrants. This Eternal tricks his opponents into defeating themselves.

coreAbility.name: Disquieting Metamorphosis
coreAbility.description: Explode into crystal fragments, damaging nearby enemies.

setBonus.name: Malleable
setBonus.description: Increase Healing from your Items and Abilities by 50%

name: Grimwold
title: The Scientist
description: The memories of a genius and a fool. Grimwold uses his mastery of science to dictate the flow of battle. This Eternal uses turrets, teleporters, and barriers, littering the battlefield with deadly inventions.

coreAbility.name: Magnetic Field
coreAbility.description: Create a magnetic field that increases the movement speed of teammates and slows enemies.

setBonus.name: Galvanized
setBonus.description: Fortitude and Health Regenerate if you have not received or dealt damage in the past 3 seconds

name: Penelope
title: The Porcelain Girl
description: The memories of a young woman who was told she was fragile. Penelope is built by lies. This Eternal fires crystalline shards that detonate in brilliant displays of glittering light.

coreAbility.name: Look How I Shine
coreAbility.description: A wave of shattered pieces that passes through enemies and deals crushing damage.

name: Tsu'bo
title: The Stray
description: The memories of a stray from the old world. Tsu'bo is the last of his kind. This Eternal is a pack hunter that remembers his hound and runs alongside him.

coreAbility.name: Cull the Herd
coreAbility.description: A primal scream that lacerates enemies, causing them to bleed. Scream damage is multiplied based on the number of enemies hit (max 3).

setBonus.name: Endling
setBonus.description: Deal 70% more damage at low health (100HP)
